commentary.text: 90+5' 3 - 0 That's it for today, Stuart Attwell has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+2' John McGinn (Aston Villa) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
90+2' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) will take a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Today's referee Stuart Attwell rightly decides to book Joao Felix (Chelsea) for his harsh tackle.

89' Joao Felix (Chelsea) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Robin Olsen pulls off an easy save.
86' Here is a change. Romeo Lavia is going off and Enzo Maresca gives the last tactical orders to Malo Gusto (Chelsea).
86' Substitution. Cole Palmer did his best and is replaced by Joao Felix (Chelsea).
85' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
84' That's the end of the game for Ollie Watkins, who is replaced by Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).

83' 3 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Cole Palmer (Chelsea) and Noni Madueke gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the top left corner. 3:0.
82' Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
82' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
80' 5:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
75' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
74' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Stuart Attwell who sees an offensive foul.
74' Aston Villa fail to score from a corner as Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) leaps to collect the ball.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing. The linesman points to the corner flag, Aston Villa are going to take it.

72' John McGinn (Aston Villa) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
71' The resulting corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is cleared by the defence.
71' Enzo Maresca has decided to substitute Nicolas Jackson and he is replaced by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea).
71' The substitution is prepared. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jadon Sancho.
70' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jadon Sancho (Chelsea). Chelsea win a corner.
69' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
66' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Morgan Rogers is replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
66' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) replacing Jaden Philogene.
65' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
62' Substitution. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Boubacar Kamara walks off.
61' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card for infringement.
61' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
60' Wesley Fofana is being substituted because of an injury. Enzo Maresca sends Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) on the pitch.
58' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

58' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out John McGinn (Aston Villa) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
57' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.

57' Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' The referee Stuart Attwell awards Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) a yellow card.
54' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

53' CHANCE! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
52' The linesman signals that Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

49' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.

46' John McGinn (Aston Villa) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Robert Sanchez has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Emiliano Martinez is replaced by Robin Olsen (Aston Villa).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.

45+2' Robert Sanchez was forced into action to thwart Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
42' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

41' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Emiliano Martinez, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
40' The total number of attempts is 8:2.
36' 2 - 0 Goal! Cole Palmer slips it to Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom right corner with a great effort. The score is 2:0.
35' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
34' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle as Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
33' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
32' The resulting corner from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
32' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
31' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emiliano Martinez, who smothers the ball.
29' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Chelsea.

26' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez makes a nice save.
25' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) will take an indirect free kick from inside the box.
23' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Emiliano Martinez is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
22' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
20' The ball possession is 57:43.
17' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Levi Colwill (Chelsea), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.

15' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom right corner, but great anticipation by Robert Sanchez allowed him to make a comfortable save.
14' The linesman raises his flag. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is adjudged offside.

13' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
13' Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) finds free space in the penalty box and sends in a first-time shot. It's a poor effort which goes miles wide of the left post.
12' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and signals a foul after Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) brought his opponent down.
11' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
9' The game is interrupted now, Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' 1 - 0 Marc Cucurella plays a neat ball into the path of Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the left post! 1:0.
6' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' The ball is cleared after John McGinn (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman signals a throw-in for Chelsea.
2' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
